run_check_solutions_main: run the main function to validate all PHYRE solutions against their corresponding tasks and print statistics
run_yield_is_solution: run yield_is_solution to check if a list of solutions correctly solves a given PHYRE task file
test_yield_is_solution: test yield_is_solution by passing a task filename and solution filenames to verify correctness
review_main: review the main function that groups tasks and solutions by key and validates each solution against its task
summarize_yield_is_solution: summarize yield_is_solution which deserializes a task, loads each solution, and yields boolean validity results
